# @horuse/svelte-dnd

A drag-and-drop library for Svelte 5 with animated drop previews, auto-scroll, pointer & touch support, keyboard navigation, and multi-container layouts.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started.md): Installation and basic setup of @horuse/svelte-dnd
- [DndController API](/docs/dnd-controller-api.md): Full API reference for DndController — reactive getters, event callbacks, methods, and types
- [Sensors](/docs/sensors.md): Pluggable input sensors — configure PointerSensor and KeyboardSensor or write your own. Supports Distance, Delay start conditions
- [Collision Detection](/docs/collision.md): Pluggable collision algorithms — centerPoint, cursorOver, overlap, closestCenter, or custom
- [Modifiers](/docs/modifiers.md): Transform modifiers that constrain or snap ghost movement during drag
- [Accessibility](/docs/accessibility.md): Keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, and screen-reader announcements
- [Simulations](/docs/simulations.md): Programmatically trigger drag animations with DndSimulator for undo/redo, onboarding, or demo sequences
- [Custom Strategies](/docs/custom-strategies.md): Replace or extend built-in drop zone strategies, or add entirely new container modes

## Componentss

- [DndProvider](/docs/components-api/DndProvider.md): Root provider component — props, ghost snippet, and CSS variables
- [DndDraggable](/docs/components-api/DndDraggable.md): Draggable item component — props, events, CSS variables, and drag handle attributes
- [DndDroppable](/docs/components-api/DndDroppable.md): Drop zone component — props, direction, mode, and type filtering

## Reference

- [CSS Custom Properties](/docs/css-custom-props.md): Reference for all --dnd-* CSS custom properties and CSS classes
- [HTML Attributes](/docs/html-attributes.md): Reference for all data-dnd-* HTML attributes set and consumed by the library
- [FAQ](/docs/faq): Common questions and answers about usage, configuration, and known limitations
- [Migrating from v0.3.0](/docs/migrations/v0.3.0.md): How to migrate to @horuse/svelte-dnd v1 from v0.3.0

## Examples

- [Vertical List](/examples/vertical.md): Simple vertical sortable list with auto-scroll
- [Horizontal List](/examples/horizontal.md): Horizontal sortable list using direction="horizontal"
- [Multi Container](/examples/multi-container.md): Kanban board with multiple DndDroppable containers
- [Sortable Containers](/examples/sortable-containers.md): Draggable columns and tasks with nested DndDroppable
- [Custom Ghost](/examples/custom-ghost.md): Custom ghost snippet with scoped preview styling
